Sparse saturated orange yellow primary actions
Constant glass navigation that scrolls away with the page
Approved Builder. Researcher. Endlessly curious. and introduction copy

changes: Self-hosted Manrope for interface and reading text, Geist Mono for code
Tailwind type scale and shared spacing values, balanced headings and responsive line breaks
Compact floating glass navigation with a flat translucent surface
Two leading project cards and three full-width cards on desktop; five matching cards on mobile
Counts drawn from real project and publication records beside the primary action

Larger touch targets, visible focus, and reduced motion / forced color fallbacks

motion.implementation: IntersectionObserver, once per element; CSS transform and opacity. No scroll listener, looping artwork, or moving background.
motion.reducedMotion: Content is visible by default. Reduced-motion users get the final state. The source paths were reviewed; the OS preference was not changed.
motion.companionDecision: design-to-motion was consulted. These editorial cards do not need product story loops or video exports.

approvedScopeDecisions: This is a portfolio, so its authored work and research provide proof rather than commercial offers, trial guarantees, or invented testimonials.
Blue gray dark surfaces and the existing artwork blending preserve the requested palette and approved image treatment.
The fitted 57-row timeline retains viewport-scaled type to satisfy the explicit fit-all requirement.
Technical project names, source articles, and code retain their authored punctuation. The separate Unwind explainer source remains owned by the parallel author.

verification.build: 132 pages; internal links, anchors, media, and static resources verified.
